description: D6.6 Dataset of turbine properties of Lillgrund wind park is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Benjamin Adrian, Upwards Consortium (Fraunhofer ITWM). This dataset was used in Deliverable 6.6 of Upwards. It contains turbine properties of turbines in a simulation of the Lillgrund wind park. The simulation was conducted for different yaw misalignments of the turbines in the freestream. Thus this dataset contains 4 folders which each correspond to one yaw misalignment. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2022. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
